name: shipflow
description: Self-hosted, CLI-first release and deployment automation for static sites

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p cli/tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm --filter shipflow-ui typecheck
scripts.dev: nodemon --watch src --watch index.ts --ext ts --ignore dist/ --exec "pnpm build && node dist/index.js"
scripts.dev:worker: nodemon --watch src --watch worker.ts --ext ts --ignore dist/ --exec "pnpm build && node dist/worker.js"
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test --import ./test/unit/setup.js "test/unit/*.test.js" && pnpm --filter shipflow-ui test
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test

author: Shiv Singh Baghel
